recognize_zh: 中倍鏡下骨小樑增厚、輪廓不規則且邊緣呈扇貝狀凹陷，彼此吻合成網；骨髓腔被含小血管的疏鬆纖維血管性組織取代，幾乎不見造血細胞，符合 Paget 骨病。
features: Thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with scalloped (resorption bay) contours
Osteocytes in lacunae within the trabeculae; faint irregular lamellar pattern
Marrow spaces filled with loose, edematous fibrovascular connective tissue containing numerous small vessels
Near absence of hematopoietic cells in the marrow spaces
No infiltrate of tumor cells or granulomas identified
describe_en: Section of bone marrow trephine at intermediate power shows increased bone with thickened, irregular, anastomosing trabeculae displaying scalloped resorption contours. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by loose, edematous fibrovascular connective tissue with numerous small vessels, and hematopoietic elements are nearly absent. No metastatic tumor or granulomas are seen. Findings are consistent with Paget disease of bone in the appropriate radiologic and biochemical context.

ddx.vs: Metastases show keratin-positive epithelial nests within desmoplastic stroma, absent here.
Hyperparathyroidism shows dissecting tunneling resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis and abnormal PTH/calcium, without a mosaic cement-line pattern.
Fibrous dysplasia has curvilinear woven-bone 'Chinese character' trabeculae without osteoblastic rimming in a cellular fibrous stroma, rather than thick lamellar trabeculae with resorption bays.
